identity.name: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bear 3X Shares (Reality Tokenized)

about.description: rSOXS is a tokenized share of the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bear 3X Shares issued by Reality on Arbitrum, designed to track the economic performance of Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bear 3X Shares (SOXS) at a 1:1 ratio. The underlying ETF provides -3x daily inverse semiconductor sector exposure and is designed for short-term trading rather than long-term holding due to compounding effects. Each rSOXS is backed by a corresponding ETF share held through Alpaca Securities LLC, a FINRA-registered and SIPC-covered US broker-dealer, with reserves continuously verified by The Network Firm through Reality's Proof of Asset dashboard. Reality is a regulated RWA issuance platform within the Bitget ecosystem.
about.registryInfo: Reality is a licensed real-world asset issuance platform operating as a subsidiary of the Bitget exchange group. Underlying securities are custodied through Alpaca Securities LLC (FINRA CRD 288202, SEC file 8-69928), a FINRA-registered and SIPC-covered US broker-dealer. Proof of asset attestations are performed by The Network Firm LLP, a Miami-headquartered CPA firm specializing in digital-asset and RWA attestations via its LedgerLens real-time attestation platform. rTokens are issued on Arbitrum One with 24/5 mint and redemption, on-chain dividend distributions in stablecoins, and automatic handling of stock splits and corporate actions.
